notes: Adds the barebones Concepts / Starters system. Concepts are editable starter skins that populate the normal editor controls instead of locking users into presets. Includes separate Starter Library and My Concepts tabs, search, Save Current as Concept, local persistence, concept cards with palette previews, Load & Edit, Apply Selected, delete for personal concepts, import/export .ao3concept JSON files, hosted image/GIF URL preservation, gradient snapshots, and an updater-ready built-in concept schema so future concepts can be delivered directly into the Starter Library. No specific built-in concept is included yet. Keeps the app icon, Desktop Shortcut setting, full AO3 Required-Tag Grid editor, Color Studio, Gradient Studio, GIF support, Split Screen, and all prior tools.
